# Transgenic Drosophila Turning Drug Discovery Dead Ends into Runways | Future Fields at PEGS 2026


Presentation Recording & Slides


Presenter: Matt Anderson-Baron, PhD, co-founder and CEO of Future Fields


---


> > **“What project did you shelve because you couldn’t access the protein you needed?”**
> >
> >
> > This is the question that Matt Anderson-Baron, co-founder and CEO of Future Fields asked the audience at PEGS Boston 2026.
> >
> >
> > Walking through four major protein production bottlenecks for drug discovery programs, Matt addresses how complex protein projects can be rescued with our *Drosophila* -based platform.
